Day 2:
Lower Body:
A1. Elevated Pigeon Stretch x 20-30s hold per side x 3 sets, rest 20s
A2. Couch Stretch x 30s w/ intermitten active contraction into bench x 3 sets, rest 90s

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1x_x97fRJiY
*pigeon

B. Front Squat: In 5 sets, build to a challenging 3.
*this is not a 3RM, this is just something heavy you feel confident moving.
+
Plyo Progression:
C. Light Tier Leap + Tuck Jump: 3 sets x 2-5 complexes (2+1), rest as needed.
*You don't have to be super aggressive on the tuck jump yet. Just working on leaving the ground a bit higher and getting your knees up.
D. Medium Tier Leaps - lateral: 3 x 3-6 reps per direction, rest as needed.
E. Medium Tier Hop (single leg): 3 sets x 3-5 reps per side, rest as needed.

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7aoP4KTzw1A
*can be stationary like this or forward traveling (medium tier hop)

Run/Walk Progression:
F. 18-20 Sets:
30s Run @ 60 minute effort (~12:30/mile)
30s Walk

Upper Body:
A1. 90/90 ER Walkout Hold x 20-30s hold x 2-3 sets, rest 30s
A2. DB External Rotation Eccentric (only) x 3-5 reps x 2-3 sets, rest 2 minutes
*around 20# - around a 5s eccentric

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-T-CWoaF6B0
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JQHttlGoDic

B. Strict Pull-up: 4 x 3.2.1, rest 20s b/t clusters, rest 2 minutes.
*general control over the eccentric

C. Lat Pulldown: 3 x 12 reps, rest 2 minutes.
*8-8.5/10 RPE 

D1. DB Skull Crushers x 12 reps x 2-3 sets, rest 60s
D2. DB Supianted Bicep Curls x 12 reps x 2-3 stes, rest 90-120s
